svg.title: A generic synovial joint: separate cartilage, capsule, lining and cavity
svg.desc: Opposed bone ends have separate articular cartilage caps. An outer fibrous capsule joins the bones outside those surfaces; synovial membrane lines its inner nonarticular surface and does not cover the cartilage. A fluid-containing joint cavity lies between the surfaces. One extrinsic ligament is shown outside the capsule. This original unscaled section is not an MRI segmentation or the Open Knee(s) specimen.
svg.text: One joint cavity, several different tissue boundaries
Generic section; enlarged gap and linings; illustrative colors, no common scale with the MRI
Gray band: one extrinsic ligament. Menisci and other joint-specific structures are omitted.
Topology checked against OpenStax A&P 2e §9.4; original geometry, not copied source artwork.
